scope: Manufacturer facts about fragrance identity; these are not confirmations of Drip & Dusk's stock, size, price or condition.

products.name: Glitch
products.description: A citrus and raspberry opening develops into orange blossom and vetiver, finishing with vanilla and ambroxan.
discrepancies: Current manufacturer standalone page is 125ml; many retailers list 150ml. This may reflect formats or packaging changes, but that explanation is not verified. Do not assign a stocked size without seller confirmation.
Fragrantica's launch article claims 100ml and links to an unrelated Wild Colt product. Prefer the actual manufacturer listing.
Source Beauty lists a different lemon/mint/lavender/nutmeg/amber/cedarwood pyramid; rejected in favor of Assaf's own Glitch pyramid.

products.name: Attacks
products.normalizationNote: The official English page translates its woody heart as 'Akigalawood Patchouli' and 'Georgian Wood'. Retailers use the established aromatic-material names Akigalawood and Georgywood; the normalized display names retain that identity and do not add separate heart patchouli.
products.notesEvidence: manufacturer, with retailer normalization of two translated material names
products.description: Basil, pepper, freesia and vetiver lead into modern woody and floral accords, with patchouli and ambrofix at the base.
products.manufacturerConcentrationWording: High Concentration; no standard EDP/Parfum concentration stated
discrepancies: Current manufacturer page is 125ml, whereas a retailer lists 150ml with a different SKU. Confirm the store's actual bottle format.
The official FAQ loosely mentions bergamot, saffron and oud although those do not appear in its explicit Aromatic Composition. The structured composition is preferred over the generic FAQ copy.
Do not substitute the distinct Attacks Blue pyramid.

products.name: Boisée
products.description: Bergamot, incense and violet introduce a rose, leather and cypress heart, followed by musk, patchouli and cedarwood.
discrepancies: Some retailers call Boisée Eau de Parfum. The manufacturer explicitly calls the classic 150ml bottle Extrait de Parfum.
The separate official gift-set listing has a 100ml title but a 150ml description. Use the unambiguous standalone 150ml listing for this product.

products.name: Cuir
products.description: Pineapple, bergamot and pepper brighten an incense, geranium and labdanum heart, over patchouli, an oud accord and vetiver.
products.manufacturerConcentrationWording: Perfum in English title; بارفيوم in the official Arabic URL
discrepancies: Several retailers show only pineapple/bergamot, incense, patchouli/oud. The manufacturer's full structured pyramid additionally lists black pepper, geranium, labdanum and vetiver.
Some retailers call it Eau de Parfum. Manufacturer title calls it Perfum/Parfum.
The manufacturer narrative loosely places patchouli in the heart; its explicit structured pyramid places patchouli in the base. Use the structured pyramid.
Retain the manufacturer's named accord Oud Onyx Delair Base, or display it as Oud accord with the exact label in provenance; do not interpret it as a separate concentration or ingredient claim.

products.name: Noir
products.description: Plum, raspberry and bergamot open into orris, rose and frankincense, with a leather, guaiac wood and tobacco finish.

sources.note: This older/simplified official page says top berries, heart iris, base tobacco/oud/leather.

discrepancies: Another official Bahrain URL gives a simplified berries/iris/tobacco-oud-leather pyramid. Prefer the complete, consistent current global and Qatar structured listing; record the discrepancy rather than merging oud into the current base.
Olibanum is frankincense; either label is appropriate for display.
The SEO URL says oud/dark wood/musk, but the actual structured product pyramid does not list musk. Do not derive extra notes from the URL.
